messages.local_staff.missing_engine: Local staff recognition is not deployed. Run scripts/setup-native-staff-omr.ps1 or retain tools/omr-native.
messages.local_staff.incomplete_engine: The local recognition runtime or English OCR data is incomplete. Redeploy the local OMR component.
messages.local_staff.temporary_failed: Local recognition temporary files could not be created. The current score is unchanged.
messages.local_staff.process_guard_faile: Local recognition process management failed. The current score is unchanged.
messages.local_staff.process_failed: Local recognition engine failed: %1. Cancel or retry; the current score is unchanged.
messages.local_staff.timeout: Local recognition exceeded %1 seconds and was stopped. The current score is unchanged.
messages.local_staff.invalid_export: The local recognition export is invalid. The current score is unchanged.
messages.local_staff.multiple_exports: Local recognition exported multiple independent scores. Process separate pages or movements.
messages.local_staff.missing_export: Local recognition did not produce readable MusicXML. Check image clarity and engine diagnostics.
messages.local_staff.review: This is a local automatic recognition candidate, not corrected ground truth. Compare clefs, key, meter, pitch, duration, ties and all voices with the original. Markers request review; they are not calibrated accuracy probabilities.
messages.local_staff.failed: Local staff recognition failed. The current score is unchanged.
messages.local_staff.cancelled: Local staff recognition cancelled. The current score is unchanged.
messages.local_staff.program_requires_st: This instrument option requires a complete staff-score project.
ui.local_staff.started: Staff image opened and local recognition started; no API key or automatic upload.
ui.local_staff.running: Recognizing locally: %1. The original is visible; review results when ready.
ui.local_staff.ready: Local candidate: %1 · %2 complete-score notes. Review and confirm to apply.
ui.local_staff.original_pending: This is the original image; local recognition is running in the background. The current project is unchanged until you review and apply the candidate.
ui.local_staff.replace_message: Load the complete candidate from %1 into the main window? First compare all voices and rhythms with the original.
ui.local_staff.applied: Local candidate applied with %1 complete-score notes. Review before saving.
ui.local_staff.exit_running: Stop local recognition of %1 and exit?
cli.local_staff.recognize: Recognize a staff image offline and create a review candidate
cli.local_staff.check: Verify local staff task, cancellation, preview and integrity
ui.local_staff.ai_source_missing: The original for local recognition is retained for this import session. Reopen the original before AI review so a redrawn score is not mistaken for the source image.
cli.local_staff.real_check: Verify real local staff image recognition, confirmation, instruments and WAV
cli.local_staff.real_image: Image input for real local staff recognition verification
messages.local_staff.native_missing: Native staff recognition is not deployed. Run scripts/setup-native-staff-omr.ps1 in development, or preserve tools/omr-native in the portable package.
messages.local_staff.native_model_missin: The native OMR model is missing or unreadable: %1.
messages.local_staff.native_model_hash: The native OMR model failed its checksum. Redeploy the model.
messages.local_staff.native_structure: Native OMR did not produce a complete, compatible staff and measure structure. Review the source image and diagnostics.
cli.native_staff.core_check: Verify native OMR decoding, image anchors and failure states
messages.local_staff.native_rhythm_revie: The model output has conflicting rhythm clocks. This review candidate retains pitches and per-note durations without automatic beat padding or correction; shared onsets use the record-clock interpretation. Review and correct measure lengths, onsets and durations in the staff-note correction dialog.
